element.name: Customer Relationship Management
element.documentation: The ability to manage and develop a positive customer relationship.

element.name: Customer Onboarding
element.documentation: The ability to successfully onboard and implement customers to the DSV business

element.name: Customer Integration Management
element.documentation: The ability to integrate customers and manage the lifecycle of the integrations

element.name: Customer Retention Management
element.documentation: The ability to retain customers by ensuring positive customer experience by addressing their needs and build long-term relationships e.g. through activities such as customer visits, consistent communication, etc.

element.name: Customer Churn Management
element.documentation: The ability to analyse and mitigate customer churn by understanding why customers leave, predict potential churn, and implement measures to reduce churn rates

element.name: Account Management
element.documentation: The ability to support, advise, and manage customer accounts e.g. larger customers

element.name: Customer Analysis
element.documentation: The ability to analyse the customers' supply chains and identify needs to generate sales

element.name: Customer Contract Management
element.documentation: The ability to manage customer contracts throughout Their lifecycle from initial draft to termination

element.name: Negotiate Customer Contract
element.documentation: The ability to negotiate and agree on the details of a contract resulting in a legal binding and mutual commitment.

element.name: Customer Data Management
element.documentation: The ability to pull together data from multiple sources and systems such as CRM and ERP systems and assigning customer identifiers to data so that records are grouped by customer

element.name: Customer Agreement Management
element.documentation: The ability to utilize and manage customer agreements

element.name: Customer Service Management
element.documentation: The ability to interact with customers in different ways to enhance customer experience, customer satisfaction and customer relationship.

element.name: Customer Support Management
element.documentation: The ability to support customers with questions and issues to ensure a good customer experience

element.name: Complaint Management
element.documentation: The ability to handle customer complaints related to purchase and delivery of products and services to improve customer satisfaction and retain loyalty.

element.name: Booking Management
element.documentation: The ability to capture, register and manage a booking with the necessary information allowing it to be planned and executed

element.name: Booking Receival and Validation
element.documentation: The ability to receive and validate a booking based on the received details and information

element.name: Booking Updating and Cancellation
element.documentation: the ability to manage customer booking updates and cancelations received through various channels

element.name: Booking Routing
element.documentation: the ability to route bookings to responsible executional division, business unit, or supplier

element.name: Marketing Management
element.documentation: the ability to conduct marketing towards regions, markets, customers, partners with the purpose of generating sales and brand awareness

element.name: Market Intelligence
element.documentation: the ability to develop and utilise intelligence to understand and gain insights about markets and customers

element.name: Customer Channel Management
element.documentation: the ability to identify, develop and operate a number of different market channels matching customer and market trends and needs/requirements.

element.name: Sales Management
element.documentation: the ability to develop a sales force, coordinating sales operations and implementing sales techniques that allow a business to consistently hit, and even surpass, its sales targets

element.name: Cross-selling and Upselling
element.documentation: the ability to identify opportunities to introduce additional products/services to existing customers (cross-selling) or encourage upgrades (upselling)

element.name: Lead Qualification
element.documentation: the ability to assess and qualify leads generated through various channels, prioritizing opportunities and allocating resources effectively.

element.name: Rate Management
element.documentation: the ability to determine internal and external rates for products and services.

element.name: Rate Determination
element.documentation: the ability to determine sales/freight rates for products and services.

element.name: Profit and Margin Management
element.documentation: the ability to determine the profit and margin for products and services.

element.name: Rate Analytics
element.documentation: the ability to analyse rate performance to get insight into improving sales execution of products and services.

element.name: Price and Quote Management
element.documentation: the ability to develop prices and quotes for customers.

element.name: Self Service Quoting
element.documentation: the ability for customers to access and use a self-service quoting capability and receive quotes whenever they want

element.name: Spot Quote / One Off Quote
element.documentation: the ability to develop a spot / one off quote

element.name: Tariff Quote / Quotation
element.documentation: the ability to develop a tariff quote / quotation

element.name: Sales Rate Simulation
element.documentation: the ability to simulate customer specific rates based on customer data and shipment details

element.name: Rebate and Discount Determination
element.documentation: the ability to determine and handle rebate and discounts as part of determining quotes and prices

element.name: Tender Management
element.documentation: the ability to manage a tender process from request to analysis and generation of tender offer/bid to submit, or to manage the process as tender owner, receiving offers/bids and evaluating before awarding contract to the winner

element.name: Tender Quote
element.documentation: the ability to develop a tender quote as response to e.g. RFQ

element.name: Tender Development
element.documentation: the ability to participate in a process to analysis and meet tender customer requests.

element.name: Product and Service Development
element.documentation: the ability to innovate, enhance, and develop products or services offered by the business to meet evolving market and customer needs.

element.name: Product and Service Design Development
element.documentation: the ability to design, prototype, and develop service offerings to meet market needs across transport modes, customer segments, and industry verticals or to utilize opportunities to develop stronger value propositions.

element.name: Product and Service Testing
element.documentation: The ability to test and evaluate a new or existing product to assess key areas like quality, performance etc.

element.name: Product and Service Catalogue Management
element.documentation: the ability to define, maintain, and promote a comprehensive catalogue of transportation and logistics service offerings, including pricing and configurations

element.name: Product and Service Definition and Catalogue Maintenance
element.documentation: the ability to define and maintain a comprehensive catalogue of transportation and logistics products and services

element.name: Product and Service Documentation
element.documentation: the ability to document all aspects of how a product or service functions and all its features

element.name: Product and Service Accessibility
element.documentation: the ability to ensure that services are easily accessible to customers and effectively promoted through marketing efforts

element.name: Transport Network Management
element.documentation: the ability to develop, operate, and optimize a transportation network consisting of zones, hubs, and lanes

element.name: Zones Management
element.documentation: the ability to manage geographical subdivisions of a transportation network through a number of zones

element.name: Hub Management
element.documentation: the ability to manage a number of hubs across the transport network

element.name: Network Optimization
element.documentation: the ability to optimize the transport network across zones, hubs and lanes

element.name: Transport Scheduling Management
element.documentation: the ability to manage and utilise a set of transportation schedules as part of planning shipments

element.name: Visibility Management
element.documentation: the ability to provide insights and status of logistics operations to ensuring overview and transparency through tracking and notifications.

element.name: Transport Tracking Management
element.documentation: the ability to track transports during the lifecycle of planning and execution

element.name: Freight Monitoring Management
element.documentation: the ability to monitor the freight during the transportation lifecycle e.g. temperature

element.name: Events Management
element.documentation: the ability to define and communicate relevant events over the lifecycle of the shipment from pickup to delivery internally and externally in the right quality

element.name: Customer Notification Management
element.documentation: the ability to provide customers with notifications and relevant information related to their bookings

element.name: Exception Management
element.documentation: the ability to generate, expose, assign and monitor Exceptions to support operational excellence. Exceptions are Non-Conformities, which indicate a deviation form a happy flow and require an action to resolve them.

element.name: Network Planning
element.documentation: the ability to strategically design and manage the logistics network, optimizing routes, hubs, and resources to ensure efficient and cost-effective transportation operations.

element.name: Network Capacity Management
element.documentation: the ability to oversee and optimize the capacity of a transportation and logistics network, ensuring that resources and infrastructure are efficiently utilized to meet operational demands.

element.name: Operational Routing Determination
element.documentation: the ability to determine the route for cargo shipments from pick-up to delivery location with predetermined stops in between e.g. specific terminals in our network

element.name: Transport Scheduling Management
element.documentation: the ability to manage and utilise a set of transportation schedules as part of planning shipments

element.name: Insurance Management
element.documentation: the ability to offer and deliver shipment / cargo insurance

element.name: Shipment Management
element.documentation: the ability to manage and create a number of shipments based on received orders and bookings.

element.name: Shipment Validation and Registration
element.documentation: the ability to register a shipment based on received and validated booking information

element.name: Shipment Updating and Cancelation
element.documentation: the ability to mange customer shipment updates and cancelations received through various channels

element.name: Cargo Requirements Management
element.documentation: the ability to handle and meet diverse cargo needs including different physical characteristics, packaging, handling instructions, temperature control and security measures.

element.name: Consolidation Management
element.documentation: the ability to optimise and consolidate shipments for efficient shipment and transportation

element.name: Shipment Document Management
element.documentation: the ability to manage relevant documentation related to shipments e.g. archiving of documentation

element.name: Returnable Items Management
element.documentation: the ability to handle and plan for returnable items

element.name: Shipment Routing
element.documentation: The ability to distribute shipments to responsible executional departments.

element.name: Operational Planning
element.documentation: The ability to plan relevant activities necessary to execute and secure successful operational activities in the most efficient way

element.name: Carrier, Haulier and Equipment Planning
element.documentation: the ability to select and book carriers, hauliers and equipment to execute transportation of cargo

element.name: Production Order Optimization
element.documentation: the ability to optimise production order of one or multiple shipments

element.name: Instructions Management
element.documentation: the ability to create and provide relevant instructions to parties involved in the shipment transportation flow

element.name: Intermodal Instructions Management
element.documentation: the ability to produce and manage instructions for intermodal transports

element.name: Driver Instructions Management
element.documentation: the ability to produce and manage transport and shipment instructions for drivers

element.name: Terminal Instructions Management
element.documentation: the ability to produce and manage instructions for terminals, both internally and externally

element.name: Partner and Agent Instructions Management
element.documentation: the ability to produce and manage shipment and transport instructions for agents or partners

element.name: Transportation Execution Management
element.documentation: the ability to execute transportation of cargo

element.name: Haulier and Driver Communication Management
element.documentation: the ability to communicate with drivers and hauliers during the transport execution of shipments to share and exchange necessary information and details

element.name: Stop Execution Management
element.documentation: the ability to perform a predefined sequence of stops or adjust and change the sequence during execution

element.name: Terminal Handling
element.documentation: the ability to register/scan and stores and process shipments through a terminal in different ways

element.name: Cross Dock Management
element.documentation: the ability to cross dock shipments from unloading trucks to loading on to new trucks

element.name: Terminal Service Management
element.documentation: the ability to manage and provide terminal services e.g. re-wrapping/labeling

element.name: Terminal Planning Management
element.documentation: the ability to plan the handling for shipments and trucks arriving and departing from the terminal in most efficient way

element.name: Warehouse Management
element.documentation: the ability to efficiently oversee and control warehouse operations, optimizing inventory storage, layout, and logistics processes to ensure smooth goods flow in and out of the facility.

element.name: Yard Management
element.documentation: the ability to manage a yard facility

element.name: Dock Management
element.documentation: the ability to manage a number of docks

element.name: Gate Management
element.documentation: the ability to manage various gates around a yard facility

element.name: Fleet and Equipment Management
element.documentation: the ability to effectively procure, maintain, and optimize fleet and equipment assets to support operational needs

element.name: Intenal Trailer Management
element.documentation: the ability to manage and maintain trailers, including tracking their condition and availability

element.name: Local Fleet and Truck Management
element.documentation: The ability to manage and maintain local fleets, including tracking their condition and availability, scheduling and tracking of maintenance

element.name: Internal Machinery and Tools Management
element.documentation: The ability to manage and maintain machinery and tools, including tracking their condition, scheduling and tracking of maintenance

element.name: Maintenance Scheduling and Tracking
element.documentation: the ability to schedule and track maintenance activities for fleet and equipment to optimize their performance and longevity

element.name: Fleet and Equipment Optimization
element.documentation: the ability to optimize the usage and performance of the entire fleet and equipment inventory for operational efficiency

element.name: External Equipment Management
element.documentation: the ability to effectively manage hauliers, external equipment, and documentation ensuring their proper utilization and compliance

element.name: Claims Management
element.documentation: the ability to manage and resolve claims related to provided or received service.

element.name: Inventory Management
element.documentation: The ability to track, manage and optimize the levels of goods and materials

element.name: Storage and Staging Location Management
element.documentation: The ability to storage and manage goods in different location types and manage their availability.

element.name: Agreement Management / Tariff and Rate Management
element.documentation: the ability to maintain, manage and update the offer/rate base

element.name: Internal Agreement Management / External Tariff and Rates Management
element.documentation: the ability to manage internal agreement between business units or departments within the business

element.name: External Agreement Management / Internal Tariff and Rates Management
element.documentation: the ability to maintain, manage and update external customer and vendor rate base

element.name: Self-billing Management
element.documentation: the ability to handle invoices and payments prepared by a customer

element.name: Operational Controlling
element.documentation: the ability to monitor and analyse the business-related financial performance and enable informed decisions.

element.name: Operational Estimation Management
element.documentation: the ability to generate shipment and transportation unit-based estimations both cost and profit and releasing for invoicing.

element.name: Invoice Management
element.documentation: the ability to process and manage supplier invoices, including verification, approval, and posting, to ensure timely and accurate payment while maintaining proper documentation for audit purposes

element.name: Internal Settlement
element.documentation: the ability to handle settlement between organizations owning the resources used to execute orders and services.

element.name: Cost Management
element.documentation: the ability to plan and control cost associated with running the business

element.name: Denied Party Screening
element.documentation: the ability to screen parties and identify and comply with existing embargoes

element.name: Customs Management
element.documentation: the ability to manage documented permission to pass customs authority of imported goods so that they can enter the country or to exported goods so that they can leave the country

element.name: Customs Broakerage
element.documentation: The ability to ensure correct customs declarations, including duties, taxes and payments so goods can transit across boarders without disruption also on behalf of a client

element.name: Customs Export
element.documentation: The ability to ensure compliant export procedures

element.name: Customs Import
element.documentation: The ability to ensure compliant import procedures

element.name: Supplier Relationship Management
element.documentation: the ability to manage and cultivate strong relationships with suppliers to ensure collaboration, performance improvement, and process efficiency

element.name: Sourcing
element.documentation: the ability to strategically evaluate and source suppliers, establishing the relevant contract or agreements

element.name: Strategic Sourcing
element.documentation: the ability to develop and execute strategic sourcing strategies to optimize supplier selection, cost savings, and value creation

element.name: Supplier Selection and Evaluation
element.documentation: the ability to methodically select and evaluate suppliers based on criteria such as performance, risk, and compliance to ensure the right partnerships

element.name: Supplier Contract Management
element.documentation: the ability to effectively manage and oversee supplier contracts, including negotiation, compliance, and lifecycle management

element.name: Supplier Performance Management
element.documentation: the ability to monitor, assess, and improve the performance of suppliers to ensure they meet agreed-upon standards and expectations

element.name: Contract Renewal Management
element.documentation: the ability to proactively manage contract renewals, renegotiations, and terminations.

element.name: Fleet and Equipment Procurement
element.documentation: the ability to procure and acquire fleet and equipment assets to meet operational needs efficiently

element.name: Haulier Procurement
element.documentation: the ability to source and acquire haulier services to support transportation and logistics operations

element.name: Performance Management
element.documentation: The ability to set performance targets, track KPIs, and facilitate ongoing dialogue to optimise organisational performance. This ensures alignment with business objectives, timely insights, and actions to address challenges and drive improvement.
